mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num) VALUES (friend_seq.NEXTVAL, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, NULL, #{request_num}, #{response_num})
mapper.select: SELECT num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num FROM friend WHERE response_num = #{response_num} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY num DESC
SELECT num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num FROM friend WHERE request_num = #{request_num} ORDER BY num DESC
SELECT num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num FROM friend WHERE num = #{num}
mapper.update: UPDATE friend SET status = 'ACCEPTED', responsed_date = SYSDATE WHERE num = #{num} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE friend SET status = 'REJECTED', responsed_date = SYSDATE WHERE num = #{num} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num FROM friend WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (request_num = #{member_num} OR response_num = #{member_num}) ORDER BY responsed_date DESC
